name: Dragonborn
reviewNotes: Low-Light Vision replaces baseline 60-foot Darkvision for all Dragonborn families and currently playable ancestries; 30-foot walking speed remains subject to comparative Species balance. Specialized future ancestries may define their own vision and related light sensitivity.

Ordinary Draconic Wings grant gliding from level 1 and limited non-hovering flight from level 5; this is separate from temporary 5.5e Draconic Flight, Gem Spectral Flight, and exceptional Platinum/Fivefold Wings.
Languages and learned draconic traditions are deferred to independently selectable Upbringings. Ability-score adjustments remain deferred.

Dragon creature type selected in the comparative Species review. Dragon-specific targeting applies; monster Dragon Hit Dice, senses, saving throw competencies and other stat-block defaults are not automatically granted to playable characters.
